$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFGI (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Dijon - Darois

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD prohibited to non-radio equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of RWY and FATO prohibited.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
DEP 20, paved RWY: caution D 971 road 95 m from RWY end: adjust rate of climb.
Preferred QFU 017°, due to proximity of D 971 at the South and runway slope for landing.
Ground traffic: C1 to C5: Private areas access (under pilot in command's responsibility).
C1: Paved portion of the TWY to CEAPR company is 5 meters wide.
ACFT coming to/from CEAPR company exit aerodrome and cross D 971 South of TWY under pilot in command's responsibility.
Prior phone call to the company recommended (see TXT 02).
Helico circuit: Follow helico circuit published West of the field, use of ULM circuit 2100 (500) East of the Field possible for instructions flight of Helico only.
Gliders winch activity on AD (NR 946): see ENR 5.5 Aerobatics activity on AD (NR 6461): see ENR 5.5
